title: From Player to System: An Agent-Based Framework for Modeling Human Performance in Tennis

contributions.purpose: 论证网球从NTRP 2.0到5.0是可量化的系统性生物力学再造
contributions.mechanism: 综述现有文献,归纳动力链、地面反作用力、SSC、精英vs高水平球员运动学差异
contributions.evaluation: 定性(引用文献数据):精英球员肩线速度2.0 vs 1.2 m/s、骨盆角速度295 vs 168°/s、躯干453 vs 292°/s
contributions.domain: 运动科学 / 网球表现建模
contributions.source_quote: A biomechanical shift from isolated, arm-dominant movements to an efficient, integrated kinetic chain that generates power through higher angular velocities of the pelvis and trunk.

contributions.purpose: 论证认知(预判/决策)与心理(自我效能/情绪控制)维度的可测量转变
contributions.mechanism: 综述反应敏捷、感知-动作耦合、心理韧性(learned resourcefulness)、flow state文献
contributions.evaluation: 定性引文:athletic mental energy 解释 flow 66% 方差;精英运动员低未来时间视角
contributions.source_quote: A cognitive evolution from simple physical reaction to sophisticated anticipation, decision-making, and pattern recognition.

contributions.purpose: 提出结构化周期化训练蓝图
contributions.mechanism: 综述 deliberate practice 与周期化(undulating)模型
contributions.evaluation: 定性引文:deliberate practice 仅解释运动表现18%方差(games 26%、music 21%)
contributions.source_quote: The adoption of a structured, periodized training blueprint that moves beyond unstructured practice and is tailored to the athlete's phase of development.

notes: reject。四元组适配困难:本质是纯文献综述/教练指南,type 只能记 finding(全部转述他人研究,无原创数据)。最大红旗——标题-内容严重不符:题为"Agent-Based Framework for Modeling Human Performance",全文却无任何智能体、无仿真模型、无计算实验,"agent"仅出现在标题;所谓"framework"是四维叙事综述。checklist 诚实反映此点:设计=NA、分析=NA、reproducibility/code/settings/significance/compute 全 NA(自认"synthesis of existing literature","does not present new experimental results")。无自声明编号贡献列表,由摘要归纳4维度(此处并3条,训练蓝图并入C3)。参考文献含疑似不实条目(如 [1] Crespo 2020 书名与标题雷同、[11] Johnson 2025 泛作者名)。非实证类适配问题突出:与"AI Agents for Science"主题匹配度极低。checklist AI披露:Hypothesis=B、写作=B。
